title: Privilege escalation through com_users batch task
short_summary: Privilege escalation through the Joomla com_users batch task.
summary: An improper access check in the Joomla com_users batch task could allow privilege escalation.
impact: Authenticated attackers could escalate privileges through the affected com_users batch task.

timeline.event: Reported to the Joomla Security Strike Team.
Confirmation of the issue and initial patch development.
Fixed in Joomla CMS 5.4.6 and 6.1.1 and CVE assigned.

title: Authenticated blind SQL injection in com_tags
short_summary: Authenticated blind SQL injection in Joomla com_tags.
summary: Improper validation of order clauses in Joomla com_tags could allow an authenticated attacker to trigger blind SQL injection behavior.
impact: High-impact authenticated blind SQL injection. Authenticated attackers could manipulate SQL queries and infer database contents.

timeline.event: Reported to the Joomla Security Strike Team.
First acknowledgment.
Confirmation of the issue and initial patch development.
Fixed in Joomla CMS 5.4.6 and 6.1.1 and CVE assigned.

title: Authenticated blind SQL injection in com_finder
short_summary: Authenticated blind SQL injection in Joomla com_finder.
summary: Improperly built filter clauses in the Joomla com_finder search query could allow authenticated blind SQL injection.
impact: High-impact authenticated blind SQL injection. Authenticated attackers could manipulate search-query SQL and infer database contents.

timeline.event: Reported to the Joomla Security Strike Team.
First acknowledgment.
Confirmation of the issue and initial patch development.
Fixed in Joomla CMS 5.4.6 and 6.1.1 and CVE assigned.

title: Authenticated blind SQL injection in SettingsIndividual.php
short_summary: Authenticated blind SQL injection in SettingsIndividual.php.
summary: ChurchCRM settings input could be used by an authenticated user to influence a SQL query in SettingsIndividual.php and confirm injection through blind SQL techniques.
impact: Authenticated database query manipulation and sensitive data extraction through blind SQL injection.

timeline.event: Report published to ChurchCRM and initial triage.
GitHub advisory published and CVE assigned.

title: Authenticated blind SQL injection in PropertyAssign.php
short_summary: Authenticated blind SQL injection in PropertyAssign.php.
summary: ChurchCRM property assignment handling exposed a blind SQL injection path through PropertyAssign.php for authenticated users.
impact: Authenticated attackers could infer database contents and potentially alter application data through injected SQL.

timeline.event: Report published to ChurchCRM and initial triage.
GitHub advisory published and CVE assigned.

title: Authenticated blind SQL injection in EventNames.php
short_summary: Authenticated blind SQL injection in EventNames.php.
summary: ChurchCRM event-name management exposed SQL injection behavior reachable by authenticated users with access to the affected event configuration path.
impact: Authenticated SQL injection could expose or modify ChurchCRM database records.

timeline.event: Report published to ChurchCRM and initial triage.
GitHub advisory published and CVE assigned.

title: Authenticated SQL injection in MemberRoleChange.php
summary: ChurchCRM allowed authenticated users with group and role management privileges to inject SQL through the MemberRoleChange.php role update flow.
impact: Database read/write access through injected SQL, with potential privilege escalation depending on deployment configuration.

timeline.event: Report published to ChurchCRM and initial triage.
GitHub advisory published and CVE assigned.

title: Authenticated blind SQL injection in PropertyTypeEditor.php
short_summary: Authenticated blind SQL injection in PropertyTypeEditor.php.
summary: ChurchCRM property type editing accepted input that could influence SQL statements in PropertyTypeEditor.php when reached by an authenticated user.
impact: Authenticated database compromise through SQL injection, including data extraction or modification.

timeline.event: Report published to ChurchCRM and initial triage.
GitHub advisory published and CVE assigned.

title: Authenticated blind SQL injection in SettingsUser.php
short_summary: Authenticated blind SQL injection in SettingsUser.php.
summary: ChurchCRM user settings handling exposed an authenticated blind SQL injection path in SettingsUser.php.
impact: Authenticated attackers could infer and extract database data through timing-based or boolean blind SQL techniques.

timeline.event: Report published to ChurchCRM and initial triage.
GitHub advisory published and CVE assigned.

title: Second-order SQL injection via FundRaiserEditor.php
summary: ChurchCRM allowed stored input from FundRaiserEditor.php to become executable SQL later in the affected fundraiser workflow.
impact: Second-order SQL injection could lead to database compromise after malicious stored input is processed.

timeline.event: Report published to ChurchCRM and initial triage.
GitHub advisory published and CVE assigned.
